messages:
sam: Heads-up — prod alert for search latency triggered but on-call didn't get a page. Incident was created in #incidents but no PD page. @ops-bot / incident-bot any visibility?

ops-bot: [automated] Received webhook from monitor, forwarded to incident-bot (payload id=abc123). Incident-bot responded with upstream error:
```
502 Bad Gateway: read timeout from notify-bridge
trace_id=tx-0a1b2c3d
```

mira: I can confirm. Monitor shows `alert_id=search_latency_prod_2026-02-23` -> `status=triggered`. No page in PagerDuty. CS just pinged about delayed customer notifications.

jun: Looking at pagerbridge logs now — some requests are missing the `X-Notify-Signature` header and PD returns 401 for those. Reproduced locally:
```
curl -v -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"incident":"search_latency"}' 
  https://notify-bridge.internal/api/v1/relay
# response: 401 unauthorized (missing signature)
```

kelly: We rotated the notify key during the 09:00 deploy window. Did someone forget to update the incident-bot/channel config? @oncall-sre were you involved in the key rotation? :eyes:

oncall-sre: I'm oncall and I didn't touch keys. I did get a few paged alerts earlier from other routes. Manual mitigation: I just paged PD for the two impacted incidents and escalated to the oncall rotation. Will stay on until we confirm automation is back.

sam: Thx. Jun — can you patch incident-bot to fallback to the previous signing key while we fix config? We need restore ASAP (manual paging doesn't scale).

jun: Applying a temporary rollback: re-added previous env var `NOTIFY_KEY=v1-xxxxx` to incident-bot deployment and restarted the pod. Watch logs for delivery.

ops-bot: incident-bot restart triggered. Healthcheck passed. Recent deliveries: 14/15 succeeded after restart. Last error before fix:
```
2026-02-23T14:44:12Z ERROR notify-bridge: signature header missing (request_id=abc123)
```

mira: Confirmed — PD pages resumed at 14:46. CS notified customers. Creating support ticket #support-5567 for customer impact notes. Marking this as Sev2 due to delayed pages.

jun: Follow-up created: GH-1234 "incident-bot: verify notify key rotation touches channel configs and CI gate". I'll own it. Also adding an automated smoke test that signs a webhook and validates the full chain.

kelly: We should add a post-rotation checklist to the ops-runbook: update incident-bot env, update notify-bridge key store, and run `curl` smoke test.

oncall-sre: I'll draft the playbook update and coordinate on the postmortem. For immediate mitigation we should also add alerting on notify-bridge 4xx/5xx rates so automation failures create an auto-ticket/alert.

sam: Agreed. Good catch everyone. I'll start the incident timeline and include mitigation steps + customer impact.

ops-bot: Note: adding alert rule `notify-bridge.delivery_failure_rate > 0.05 for 5m` to watchlist (temp).

mira: Thanks — I'll loop in CS/Trust with the timeline and remediation notes.

sam: Postmortem owners: jun (fix + CI), kelly (runbook), mira (customer comms). We'll reconvene in the retro channel after the write-up. :thumbsup:
